rationale: With helicopter scanning complete and this being the final wave, we are deploying all three drones with none held in reserve to cover our highest-risk blind spots and disagreements. Drone 1 will survey the unscanned Rincon Annex and Pacific Gas & Electric steel block alongside the Federal Reserve Bank, while Drone 2 assesses the obscured 32 Battery St URM-infill block (up to 65% collapse risk). Drone 3 will sweep the unscanned 50 Fremont Center steel block in SoMa to check over 3,100 occupants facing severe damage predictions.

missions.purpose: Survey unscanned Rincon Annex and PG&E steel block, and resolve damage disagreement at Federal Reserve Bank.
Assess obscured 32 Battery St URM-infill block for potential collapses and trapped occupants.
Sweep unscanned 50 Fremont Center steel block to check for predicted extensive damage or collapse.
